title: GTA 6: The Top 3 Rides in Rockstar's Gameplay

short_description:
Vice Replay Rankings: the top 3 rides from Rockstar's own GTA 6 gameplay video ("GTA VI: An Extended Look"), ranked by us (our opinion). 3: the dirt bike, a 12-rider race up a canyon. 2: the airboat, across the swamp. 1: the neon street racer, 6 cars at night. No story spoilers. Which one are you driving first?

Source: Rockstar Games, GTA VI: An Extended Look.
